# Data Source SVM Audits

Retrieves audit configuration for all or matched SVMs in the cluster

## Related ONTAP commands

```commandline
* vserver audit show
```

## Supported Platforms

* On-prem ONTAP system 9.6 or higher
* Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP

## Example Usage

```terraform
# retrieving audit configuration for all SVMs in the cluster
data "netapp-ontap_svm_audits" "all_audit_configs" {
  # required to know which system to interface with
  cx_profile_name = "hw-cluster"
}

# retrieving audit configuration for matched SVMs
data "netapp-ontap_svm_audits" "matched_audit_configs" {
  # required to know which system to interface with
  cx_profile_name = "hw-cluster"
  filter = {
    svm_name = "svm*"
  }
}
```

<a id="nestedatt--protocols_svm_audits"></a>

### Nested Schema for `protocols_svm_audits`

Required:

- `cx_profile_name` (String) Connection profile name
- `svm_name` (String) The name of the SVM.

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether or not auditing is enabled on the SVM.
- `events` (Attributes) Indicates events for which auditing is enabled on the SVM. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--protocols_svm_audits--events))
- `guarantee` (Boolean) Indicates whether there is a strict Guarantee of Auditing.
- `log` (Attributes) Indicates the configuration options for audit log files. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--protocols_svm_audits--log))
- `log_path` (String) The audit log destination path where consolidated audit logs are stored.

~> **NOTE:** `guarantee` requires ONTAP 9.10 or later

<a id="nestedatt--protocols_svm_audits--events"></a>

### Nested Schema for `protocols_svm_audits.events`

Read-Only:

- `authorization_policy` (Boolean) Authorization policy change events.
- `cap_staging` (Boolean) Central access policy staging events.
- `cifs_logon_logoff` (Boolean) CIFS logon and logoff events.
- `file_operations` (Boolean) File operation events.
- `file_share` (Boolean) File share category events.
- `security_group` (Boolean) Local security group management events.
- `user_account` (Boolean) Local user account management events.

<a id="nestedatt--protocols_svm_audits--log"></a>

### Nested Schema for `protocols_svm_audits.log`

Read-Only:

- `format` (String) Describes the format in which the logs are generated by consolidation process.
									Possible values are,
									xml - Data ONTAP-specific XML log format
									evtx - Microsoft Windows EVTX log format
- `retention` (Attributes) Describes the count and time to retain the audit log file. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--protocols_svm_audits--log--retention))
- `rotation` (Attributes) Audit event log files are rotated when they reach a configured threshold log size or are on a configured schedule.
									When an event log file is rotated, the scheduled consolidation task first renames the active converted file to a time-stamped archive file,
									and then creates a new active converted event log file. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--protocols_svm_audits--log--rotation))

<a id="nestedatt--protocols_svm_audits--log--retention"></a>

### Nested Schema for `protocols_svm_audits.log.retention`

Read-Only:

- `count` (Number) Determines how many audit log files to retain before rotating the oldest log file out.
											This is mutually exclusive with duration.
- `duration` (String) Specifies an ISO-8601 format date and time to retain the audit log file.
											The audit log files are deleted once they reach the specified date/time.

<a id="nestedatt--protocols_svm_audits--log--rotation"></a>

### Nested Schema for `protocols_svm_audits.log.rotation`

Read-Only:

- `schedule` (Attributes) Rotates the audit logs based on a schedule by using the time-based rotation parameters in any combination.
											The rotation schedule is calculated by using all the time-related values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--protocols_svm_audits--log--rotation--schedule))
- `size` (Number) Rotates logs based on log size in bytes.
											Default value is 104857600.

<a id="nestedatt--protocols_svm_audits--log--rotation--schedule"></a>

### Nested Schema for `protocols_svm_audits.log.rotation.schedule`

Read-Only:

- `days` (List of Number) Specifies the day of the month schedule to rotate audit log.
													Specify -1 to rotate the audit logs all days of a month.
- `hours` (List of Number) Specifies the hourly schedule to rotate audit log.
													Specify -1 to rotate the audit logs every hour.
- `minutes` (List of Number) Specifies the minutes schedule to rotate the audit log.
- `months` (List of Number) Specifies the months schedule to rotate audit log.
													Specify -1 to rotate the audit logs every month.
- `weekdays` (List of Number) Specifies the weekdays schedule to rotate audit log.
													Specify -1 to rotate the audit logs every day.
